HIGH COURT OF MEGHALAYA
SHILLONG
NOTIFICATION
Dated, Shi Ilong, the JLm3 er, 2026
No.HCM.11/23/2026/17:The Hon-b ie Chief Justice, High Court of Nleghalaya. is pleased to
constitute a Screening Committee for the purpose of scrutinizing the service records of
Judicial Ofticers to assess their eligibility for grant of Assured Career Progression (ACP).
comprising the following Hon'ble Judges:
1. Hon-ble Mr. Justice H. S. Thangkhie\\-. Judge. High Court ofMeghalaya
2. Hon'ble Mr. Justice \V. Diengdoh. Judge, High Court ofMeghalaya
Chairman
Member
Further, the Registrar ( Judicial Service) shall act as the Secretary of the Committee and
the Registrar (Vigilance) shall also assist the Committee.
This Registry's Notification No. HCM.I1/73/2025/5 dated 18th February, 2026 stmds
superseded.
/
REGISTRAR GENERAL
